name: Care Gap Closure Agent
headline: Turn aggregate quality evidence into a safer human review queue
summary: Help quality and care-coordination teams inspect synthetic measure evidence, organize operational review cohorts, and draft unsent outreach while preserving clinical eligibility and privacy review.
capabilities: Analyze quality measures and surface high‑priority gaps
Stratify outreach based on risk, condition severity, and engagement
Identify common barriers that impacted care completion
Launch targeted multi‑channel outreach campaigns with real‑time progress tracking
value: Makes aggregate source limitations and review queues easier for quality teams to see.
Supports consistent operational cohorting without substituting an algorithm for clinical risk or eligibility review.
Speeds outreach drafting while keeping consent, privacy, accessibility, and clinical approval explicit.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Quality Manager: Gap Analysis
scenarios.prompt: Which synthetic quality measure has the largest evidence-review queue?

scenarios.title: Care Coordinator: Cohort Review
scenarios.prompt: Organize the synthetic evidence-review cohorts without clinical risk scoring.

scenarios.title: Care Coordinator: Outreach Draft
scenarios.prompt: Draft outreach for the synthetic screening measure, but do not send it or state that anyone is eligible.

scenarios.title: Clinical Operations Lead: Quality Dashboard
scenarios.prompt: Show the qualitative source-completeness dashboard and its limitations.

scenarios.title: Quality Manager: Hedis Status
scenarios.prompt: I need to prioritize care gaps for our Medicare Advantage population before the HEDIS reporting deadline. What's our current status?

scenarios.title: Quality Manager: Top Gaps
scenarios.prompt: Show me the top care gaps and which ones are most actionable.

scenarios.title: Care Coordinator: Risk Stratification
scenarios.prompt: Show me the diabetes cohort analysis with risk tiers and engagement barriers.

scenarios.title: Care Coordinator: Outreach Strategy
scenarios.prompt: Design a barrier-specific outreach strategy for the diabetes gap patients.

scenarios.title: Clinical Operations Lead: Campaign Projection
scenarios.prompt: Show me the campaign deployment plan and projected impact.

scenarios.title: Clinical Operations Lead: Monitoring Plan
scenarios.prompt: Configure monitoring for the campaign and alert me if performance drops.
